name: CustomerDailySummaries
description: The card agent's short daily summary per customer, with one suggested action, shown at the top of the customer card

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Priority customer code (text link to Customers)

columns.name: summaryDate
columns.description: The day the summary is for (Asia/Jerusalem). One row per customer and day; a rerun the same day replaces it

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Two or three Hebrew sentences: where the account stands, what changed, what matters today

columns.name: suggestedAction
columns.description: One Hebrew sentence: the single next step the agent recommends

columns.name: basis
columns.description: The facts the summary was written from, so the card can show the evidence

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for TEST- customers; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).
